summary_en: The video showcases the natural landscapes and a travel journey exploring the culture and cuisine of Chau Doc, An Giang. The host experiences a cyclo ride, visits Ba Chua Xu Temple on Sam Mountain, takes a cable car to the peak for panoramic floodplain views, and enjoys regional specialties such as linh fish hotpot, spring rolls, braised fish, and stir-fried sesbania flowers.
